parts.title: Word List 1
parts.content:
Word List 1

Detailed Meanings

📚
reflect [rɪˈflekt] v.
to show or express something
VIE: phản ánh
His face reflected his deep concentration.
📚
visual [ˈvɪʒuəl] adj.
relating to seeing or sight
VIE: thuộc thị giác
Visual learners prefer to see information presented in diagrams.
📚
auditory [ˈɔːdətɔːri] adj.
relating to the sense of hearing
VIE: thuộc thính giác
Auditory learners absorb information best through listening.
📚
kinesthetic [ˌkɪnəsˈθetɪk] adj.
relating to learning through feeling and physical activities
VIE: thuộc vận động
Kinesthetic students learn best when they can move around and touch things.
📚
simply [ˈsɪmpli] adv.
in a straightforward or plain manner
VIE: chỉ là, đơn giản
It simply means you have to study harder.
📚
additional [əˈdɪʃənl] adj.
added, extra, or supplementary to what is already present
VIE: thêm, bổ sung
We need additional time to finish the project.
📚
bird's eye view [ˌbɜːrdz aɪ ˈvjuː] n.
a general view from above
VIE: nhìn toàn cảnh
From the tower, you get a bird's eye view of the city.
📚
glimpse [ɡlɪmps] n./v.
a momentary or partial view
VIE: cái nhìn lướt qua; nhìn thoáng qua
I only caught a glimpse of the thief.
📚
catch a glimpse of [kætʃ ə ɡlɪmps əv] phrase
to see someone or something briefly
VIE: nhìn thoáng qua
Fans waited outside to catch a glimpse of the movie star.
📚
hazy [ˈheɪzi] adj.
unclear, vague, or ill-defined
VIE: mơ hồ
I only have a hazy memory of my childhood.
📚
be all ears [bi ɔːl ɪrz] idiom
to be waiting eagerly to hear about something
VIE: lắng nghe, nghe chăm chú
Tell me about your trip, I'm all ears!
📚
clear as a bell [klɪr əz ə bel] idiom
very clear or easy to hear
VIE: rành rọt và dễ nghe
The speaker's voice was as clear as a bell.
📚
ring a bell [rɪŋ ə bel] idiom
to sound familiar
VIE: nghe có vẻ quen thuộc
That name rings a bell, but I can't remember where I met him.
📚
describe [dɪˈskraɪb] v.
to give a detailed account in words
VIE: mô tả
Can you describe the man you saw?
📚
in detail [ɪn ˈdiːteɪl] phrase
including or considering all the particulars
VIE: chi tiết
She explained the plan in detail.
📚
voice [vɔɪs] v.
to express a feeling or opinion
VIE: bày tỏ, nói lên
He decided to voice his concerns at the meeting.
📚
hang in there [hæŋ ɪn ðer] idiom
to remain persistent and determined in difficult circumstances
VIE: chờ đó, kiên nhẫn
Hang in there, things will get better soon.
📚
come to grips with [kʌm tə ɡrɪps wɪθ] idiom
to begin to understand or deal with something difficult
VIE: tóm chặt lấy, bắt đầu giải quyết vấn đề
It took time to come to grips with the new software.
📚
lay one's cards on the table [leɪ wʌnz kɑːrdz ɑːn ðə ˈteɪbl] idiom
to be completely honest and open about one's intentions
VIE: chơi bài ngửa
It's time to lay our cards on the table and tell the truth.
📚
from scratch [frəm skrætʃ] phrase
from the very beginning
VIE: (bắt đầu) từ đầu
We had to build the company from scratch.
📚
hassle [ˈhæsl] n.
irritating inconvenience
VIE: điều rắc rối / phức tạp
It was such a hassle to find a parking spot.
📚
get in touch with [ɡet ɪn tʌtʃ wɪθ] phrase
to establish communication with someone
VIE: tiếp xúc với
I need to get in touch with my lawyer.
📚
pull strings [pʊl strɪŋz] idiom
to secretly use the influence you have over important people
VIE: gây sức ép, giật dây
He had to pull a few strings to get his son the job.
📚
get across [ɡet əˈkrɔːs] phrasal v.
to manage to make someone understand or believe something
VIE: làm cho (điều gì) được hiểu
We tried to get our point across, but he wouldn't listen.
📚
easy-to-read [ˌiːzi tə ˈriːd] adj.
clear and simple to understand
VIE: dễ đọc
The manual is very easy-to-read.
📚
handout [ˈhændaʊt] n.
a document given to students or reporters that contains information
VIE: tài liệu phát tay
Please pass this handout to everyone in the class.
📚
colleague [ˈkɑːliːɡ] n.
a person with whom one works
VIE: đồng nghiệp
I discussed the issue with my colleagues.
📚
rapport [ræˈpɔːr] n.
a close and harmonious relationship
VIE: mối quan hệ tốt
She has an excellent rapport with her patients.
📚
fumble [ˈfʌmbl] v.
to do something awkwardly, especially when using your hands
VIE: lóng ngóng, vụng về
He fumbled with his keys in the dark.
📚
conflict [ˈkɑːnflɪkt] n.
a serious disagreement or argument
VIE: sự xung đột, sự va chạm
There is a lot of conflict between the two groups.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the correct word to fill in the blank.

questions.content: Visual learners prefer to see information presented in ________.
questions.explanation: Visual relates to seeing or sight.

questions.explanation: Hazy means unclear, vague, or ill-defined.

questions.content: She explained the plan in ________.
questions.explanation: In detail means including or considering all the particulars.

questions.content: He had to pull a few ________ to get his son the job.
questions.explanation: Pull strings means to secretly use the influence you have over important people.

questions.content: The manual is very ________.
questions.explanation: Easy-to-read means clear and simple to understand.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the word that best matches the definition.

questions.content: A general view from above
questions.explanation: Bird's eye view is a general view from above.

questions.content: To express a feeling or opinion
questions.explanation: To voice means to express a feeling or opinion.

questions.content: A serious disagreement or argument
questions.explanation: Conflict is a serious disagreement or argument.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Mark each statement T for true or F for false.

questions.content: Kinesthetic students learn best by sitting still and listening.
questions.explanation: False. Kinesthetic relates to learning through feeling and physical activities.

questions.content: If you 'lay your cards on the table', you are being completely honest.
questions.explanation: True. Lay one's cards on the table means to be completely honest and open.

questions.content: A 'handout' is a document given to students or reporters.
questions.explanation: True. A handout contains information given to people.

parts.title: Word List 2
parts.content:
Word List 2

Detailed Meanings

📚
mostly [ˈmoʊstli] adv.
as regards the greater part or number
VIE: thường là, chủ yếu là
The visitors are mostly teenagers.
📚
contact [ˈkɑːntækt] n.
the state or condition of physical touching; communicating
VIE: sự tiếp xúc, người liên lạc
I've got a useful contact in the tax office.
📚
cater [ˈkeɪtər] v.
to provide what is needed or required
VIE: phục vụ, cung cấp
Our newspapers try to cater for all opinions.
📚
combine [kəmˈbaɪn] v.
to unite or merge
VIE: kết hợp
You can combine the two ideas into one project.
📚
quantum [ˈkwɑːntəm] n.
a discrete quantity of energy (Physics)
VIE: (vật lý) lượng tử
The scientist explained the basics of quantum mechanics.
📚
observant [əbˈzɜːrvənt] adj.
quick to notice things
VIE: hay quan sát, tinh mắt
Luckily, an observant passerby noticed the fire.
📚
memorize [ˈmeməraɪz] v.
to commit to memory; learn by heart
VIE: ghi nhớ, thuộc
Memorize 20 words a day and you'll throw the dictionary away.
📚
association [əˌsoʊʃiˈeɪʃn] n.
a mental connection between ideas or things
VIE: sự liên kết, sự liên tưởng
Her hometown has happy associations for her.
📚
overall [ˌoʊvərˈɔːl] adj.
taking everything into account
VIE: toàn bộ, toàn thể
The overall situation is improving.
📚
view [vjuː] n.
a particular way of considering or regarding something
VIE: quan điểm, cái nhìn
In my view, we should wait a few days.
📚
purpose [ˈpɜːrpəs] n.
the reason for which something is done or created
VIE: mục đích
What is the main purpose of your visit?
📚
doodle [ˈduːdl] v.
to draw or scribble idly
VIE: viết nguệch ngoạc
She was doodling in her notebook during the lecture.
📚
relay [ˈriːleɪ] v.
to receive and pass on information or a message
VIE: chuyển tiếp
She had to give in as a result of pressure relayed from her relatives.
📚
verbal [ˈvɜːrbl] adj.
relating to or in the form of words
VIE: thuộc lời nói, bằng lời nói
A verbal description differs greatly from a written description.
📚
eloquent [ˈeləkwənt] adj.
fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing
VIE: hùng hồn
She gave an eloquent speech about human rights.
📚
go into [ɡoʊ ˈɪntuː] phrasal v.
to start a particular type of work or behavior
VIE: bắt đầu hành động hoặc ứng xử theo cách nhất định
I don't want to go into the details right now.
📚
lengthy [ˈleŋkθi] adj.
especially long in duration
VIE: dài dòng
He dislikes lengthy meetings.
📚
comic [ˈkɑːmɪk] n.
a comedian or a funny story
VIE: chuyện vui
The comic at the club was very funny.
📚
average [ˈævərɪdʒ] adj.
a standard or level that is considered typical
VIE: trung bình
What was the average temperature yesterday?
📚
rhythmic [ˈrɪðmɪk] adj.
having or relating to rhythm
VIE: nhịp nhàng
They danced to the rhythmic beat of the drums.
📚
pattern [ˈpætərn] n.
a repeated decorative design or way in which something happens
VIE: kiểu, mẫu
Look at the beautiful pattern on that dress.
📚
respond [rɪˈspɑːnd] v.
to say something in reply
VIE: đáp lại, hưởng ứng
The politicians who respond the readiest to change are successful.
📚
physical [ˈfɪzɪkl] adj.
relating to the body as opposed to the mind
VIE: thuộc thể chất
Physical exercise is important for health.
📚
pointer [ˈpɔɪntər] n.
a long, thin piece of wood or metal used to point at something
VIE: thanh, que chỉ
The teacher used a pointer on the blackboard.
📚
gesture [ˈdʒestʃər] v.
to make a movement to express an idea or meaning
VIE: làm điệu bộ
He gestured for her to take a seat.
📚
be involved in [bi ɪnˈvɑːlvd ɪn] phrase
to participate or take part in something
VIE: tham gia vào
She wanted to be involved in the new project.
📚
act out [ækt aʊt] phrasal v.
to perform or behave in a certain way
VIE: đóng vai
The children acted out their favorite story.
📚
plot-oriented [plɑːt ˈɔːrientɪd] adj.
focused strongly on the storyline
VIE: về âm mưu, xoay quanh cốt truyện
It was a very plot-oriented action movie.
📚
decipher [dɪˈsaɪfər] v.
to succeed in understanding, interpreting, or identifying
VIE: giải mã
Can these experts decipher military signals?
📚
strengthen [ˈstreŋkθn] v.
to make or become stronger
VIE: củng cố
This region should strengthen the economy.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
Comprehensive Reading

What's Your Learning Mode?

Which style best sums you up as a person?
"That looks good to me."
"That sounds good to me."
"That feels good to me."

Experts say that these cues suggest a person's learning modality.
The first expression reflects a visual person. The second an auditory person. The third a kinesthetic person.

It simply means that a visual person learns through seeing, an auditory person learns through hearing and a kinesthetic person learns through moving, doing and touching.

To help you understand the three learning modes better, here are additional cues used by learners of different styles.

The visual person might say such things as "it appears to me", "bird's eye view", "pretty as a picture", "catch a glimpse of", "hazy idea", "eye to eye", and "the mind's eye".

The auditory person might say such things as "we are all ears", "it's clear as a bell", "it rings a bell", "describe in detail", "voice an opinion", "unheard of".

The kinesthetic person might say such things as "hang in there", "come to grips with", "lay your cards on the table", "start from scratch", "too much hassle", "get in touch with", "pull some strings".

sections.content: Drag and drop the correct words into the blanks.

questions.content:
1. There are three learning modes: [ 1 ], auditory and kinesthetic.

2. I only caught a [ 2 ] of the thief, so I can't really describe him.

3. There's sufficient [ 3 ] between hospitals and family doctors.

4. I wasn't sure what to do, so I took my [ 4 ] from the person sitting next to me.

5. He suddenly became wealthy, which changed his whole [ 5 ] of life.

6. The sellers [ 6 ] it as a vintage car, but I'd call it an old wreck.

7. He knew every [ 7 ] of her romance.

8. The mountains were [ 8 ] in the distance.

9. Even simple toys [ 9 ] the artistic taste of different times.

10. The [ 10 ] between Greece and Troy lasted ten years.

11. [ 11 ] 20 words a day and you'll throw the dictionary away.
questions.explanation:
1. visual (thị giác) is the learning mode that pairs with auditory and kinesthetic.
2. glimpse (cái nhìn lướt qua) matches the context of not being able to describe the thief.
3. rapport (mối quan hệ tốt) is appropriate between hospitals and family doctors.
4. cue (gợi ý) matches taking a hint from someone.
5. mode (cách thức) of life means lifestyle.
6. describe (mô tả) fits the action of the sellers.
7. detail (chi tiết) matches knowing everything about a romance.
8. hazy (mờ ảo) matches mountains in the distance.
9. reflect (phản ánh) matches toys showing the artistic taste.
10. conflict (xung đột) fits the 10-year war between Greece and Troy.
11. Memorize (ghi nhớ) is the action to throw the dictionary away.
